posts.hook: A week of outages just cost Washington's top cyber official his job
posts.caption: the white house's national cyber director was reportedly fired days after a wave of outages. about 8.8 million services still run a version potentially exposed to this week's nginx flaws, and california's attorney general subpoenaed nvidia over chips reaching china. apple is hiring to build its own ai agent. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross was "fired", a source tells Reuters
slides.desc: The president "fully supported" it. It comes days after a wave of tech outages.

terms.gloss: the white house official who coordinates federal cyber policy

slides.title: nginx2root, two days on: about ==8.8 million== services still potentially exposed
slides.desc: A companion Linux kernel bug has no fix yet. No exploitation reported so far.

terms.gloss: five flaws in nginx, software that runs a large share of web servers

slides.title: California's attorney general subpoenas Nvidia over chips reaching China
slides.desc: The probe also asks whether Nvidia misled investors, CBS reports.

slides.title: Anthropic fell about 5% after hours on its first day as a public company
slides.desc: Part of a broad AI selloff. It had opened a third above its IPO price.

slides.title: Apple is hiring an engineer to lead its own AI agent
slides.desc: The job listing describes browsing the web, working across apps and writing code.

slides.title: Android developer verification goes global from ==January 2027==
slides.desc: Apps must come from identity-verified developers, on all install sources in time.

slides.title: Researchers turn Chrome's built-in AI model into a tool for malware
slides.desc: It is already installed, vendor-signed and runs offline, so network monitoring sees nothing.

posts.hook: One day after the IPO, an Anthropic mathematician says Claude helped crack math's most famous open problem
posts.caption: an anthropic mathematician says he and claude proved the riemann hypothesis; nobody has independently verified it and the company has not commented. anthropic's stock fell as low as $87.26 as an ai selloff reached asia, and signal now blocks screenshots by default to keep phone ai agents out of private chats. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: A proof of the Riemann hypothesis is claimed, worked out with Claude
slides.desc: Posted in Lean so software can check it. It is ==not independently verified== yet.

terms.gloss: a 167-year-old unsolved problem about how prime numbers are spread
a language in which software checks every step of a proof

slides.title: Anthropic fell as low as ==$87.26== on day two, 5.1% above its IPO price
slides.desc: The AI selloff reached Asia overnight: SoftBank fell about 15%.

slides.title: Signal blocks screenshots by default to keep phone AI agents out of chats
slides.desc: Signal itself calls the protection "incomplete" and wants real controls from Apple and Google.

slides.title: An OpenSSL bug billed as a 9.8 is rated Low by the project itself
slides.desc: No attacker-controlled path is known. A routine update, not an emergency.

terms.gloss: the encryption library behind much of the internet's secure traffic

slides.title: Trump and Xi agree humans should stay involved in military AI decisions
slides.desc: A statement of principle, per the Treasury Secretary. No enforcement reported.

slides.title: SpaceX's lenders tried to bar it from launching their collateral into orbit
slides.desc: The $43B debt is secured by AI chips. Chips in space cannot be repossessed.

slides.title: The UN's top court cites Facebook posts in its Myanmar genocide ruling
slides.desc: It says the military's posts "dehumanized" the Rohingya and at times encouraged violence.
